title: Fix claim id collision on same-second re-claim
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: claim ids are `claim-<task>-<agent>-<idStamp(now)>` (src/core/mutate.ts:301) and `idStamp` is second-resolution (src/core/time.ts:23). A `claim -> release -> claim` cycle on the same task/agent within one second reuses the id, and the second claim OVERWRITES the released claim record file (src/core/store.ts:323-325), losing the release marker. The event log stays intact but the canonical claim record is silently destroyed. Fix: make claim ids collision-proof across same-second re-claims (e.g. reuse `mutationStamp`'s random suffix, or add a unique suffix like `postMessage` does).
acceptance: A test performs claim -> release -> claim on the same task and agent within the same wall-clock second and asserts both claim records exist and the first is `released`.
Claim id uniqueness does not rely on wall-clock resolution alone.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
notes: Reported as audit finding #2 (medium). Related same-root-cause task: task-handoff-id-collision.
